task_criteria:
AUG-120 AC-5: a change the corpus does not scope is reported UNSCOPED, not as a pass, with a concrete why and an evidence path. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && printf 'diff --git a/docs/README-not-in-corpus.md b/docs/README-not-in-corpus.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1111111
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/README-not-in-corpus.md
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+an unrelated doc line
' > /home/kara/.hermes/cache/scratch/aug120/unrelated.diff && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 auger.py spec align --repo-root . --spec-root specs --protocol-version 1 --diff-stdin < /home/kara/.hermes/cache/scratch/aug120/unrelated.diff ; echo rc=$? AUG-120 AC-4: the checker writes nothing to source, specs or boards and is deterministic, with status limited to pass|warn|fail. AUG-120 AC-1: the checker's documented machine-readable surface is real - the four flags emit one JSON line, and both documented checker commands agree.
